literal_meaning: just like that, one kind (ordinarily the same)
figurative_meaning_bn: ভালো নয় মন্দও নয়; মোটামুটি ভালো
figurative_meaning_en: neither good nor bad; moderately good
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ছবিটি এমনি একরকম, খুব ভালো লাগল না।
example_sentences_in_english: This movie is just okay; it didn't impress me much.
note: This idiom reflects a casual Bengali way of expressing average quality without strong judgment.
